MIRAGE.

Decoy sessions, replayable timelines and evidence an analyst can verify.

Overview

MIRAGE records activity seen by decoy services and brings it into an operator console. Each session can be replayed, and the associated evidence can be sealed for later review.

Following a decoy interaction

The dashboard places event volume, engagement state and honeytoken activity together. A reviewer can move from the overview to an engagement and consult its events before describing what happened. The portfolio dashboard uses a local synthetic feed.

Evidence after collection

An ordered hash chain gives investigators a way to verify a sealed event set later. Exported observations or candidate detection rules can then be reviewed independently of the original dashboard.

Capabilities

  • Manage service personas for directory, database and file-sharing protocols.
  • Follow recorded events through a hash chain and verify a sealed evidence set.
  • Export observations as STIX and review candidate Sigma, Suricata or YARA rules.

One workflow

  1. Decoy session
  2. Record events
  3. Seal evidence

Development

The first emulated services and command-line director grew into an operator console with session replay, an evidence vault and integration drivers.
